    rUVReactorVolume_L                  : REAL := 1.85;     (* Quartz sleeve internal irradiation volume [L] *)
    rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh                : REAL := 15.0;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    tStateTimer                         : TON;
    tAdsorptionSoakTimer                : TON;
    tEvacuationStabilizeTimer           : TON;
    tDesorptionRunTimer                 : TON;
    tRegenerationCoolTimer              : TON;
    tMineralStabilizeTimer              : TON;
    tPurgeTimer                         : TON;
    tSafetyWatchdog                     : TON;

    (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE MACHINE & CYCLE COORDINATION REGISTERS
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                              : INT  := 0;
    iPreviousState                      : INT  := 0;
    bCycleStepInitialized               : BOOL := FALSE;
    c_rCyclePeriod_s                    : REAL := 0.20;     (* 200 ms deterministic task cycle *)

    (* Loop Counters & Temporary Math Registers *)
    i                                   : INT  := 0;
    j                                   : INT  := 0;
    k_iter                              : INT  := 0;

    rTempCalc1                          : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Constant Operational Thresholds *)
    c_rMinAmbientRH_Permissive_pct      : REAL := 8.0;      (* Minimum desert ambient RH for adsorption *)
    c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC       : REAL := 125.0;    (* Critical thermal degradation ceiling for MOF-303 *)
    c_rMaxHTFSupplyTemp_degC            : REAL := 135.0;    (* Solar collector maximum permissive *)
    c_rMinStrippingVacuum_mbar          : REAL := 20.0;     (* Lower vacuum boundary *)
    c_rMaxStrippingVacuum_mbar          : REAL := 250.0;    (* Upper vacuum boundary *)
    c_rMinUVIrradiance_Trip_mWcm2       : REAL := 18.0;     (* Minimum germicidal UV intensity before diversion *)

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC LOGIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (DETERMINISTIC TASK PERIOD Ts = 200 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP HIERARCHY
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Condition 1.1: E-Stop Circuit Loss *)
IF NOT bEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate De-Energization of all Thermal and High-Vacuum Drivers *)
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
    rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
    rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
    rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
    rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
    bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
    bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
    bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
    bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
    bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE; (* Force product diversion to reject *)
    bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
    bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := TRUE;  (* Safely vent vacuum to atmosphere *)

    wAlarmWord1.0                       := TRUE;  (* E-Stop Trip Bit *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary                 := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord                   := 16#F001;
    iState                              := 999;   (* Jump immediately to failsafe emergency shutdown *)
    iActiveStateIndex                   := 999;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.2: Solar Thermal HTF Overtemperature Protection *)
IF (rSolarHTFSupplyTemp_degC > c_rMaxHTFSupplyTemp_degC) THEN
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.1            := TRUE; (* Solar HTF Overtemp *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary      := TRUE;
    iState                   := 999;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.3: MOF-303 Sorbent Matrix Critical Thermal Limit *)
IF (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) OR
   (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) OR
   (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC > c_rMaxBedTemperatureSafe_degC) THEN
    rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct := 0.0;
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.2            := TRUE; (* MOF Core Over-Temperature *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary      := TRUE;
    iState                   := 999;
END_IF;

(* Condition 1.4: Vacuum Desorption Chamber Overpressure During Desorption *)
IF (iState = 30) AND (rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar > 350.0) THEN
    rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord1.3         := TRUE; (* Chamber Vacuum Loss / Overpressure *)
    bSystemAlarmSummary   := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR CONSENSUS ENGINES
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------
   TMR ENGINE 1: MOF Bed Core Temperature RTD Bank (Channels A, B, C)
   ------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bTMR1_ChanA_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);
bTMR1_ChanB_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);
bTMR1_ChanC_Valid := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC >= c_rTMR1_MinRange_degC) AND
                     (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC <= c_rTMR1_MaxRange_degC);

rTMR1_Diff_AB := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC);
rTMR1_Diff_BC := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC);
rTMR1_Diff_CA := ABS(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC - rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC);

IF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rTMR1_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND
       (rTMR1_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND
       (rTMR1_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Standard Median 2oo3 Voting *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC
                              - MIN(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC, MIN(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC, rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC))
                              - MAX(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC, MAX(rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC, rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC));
        iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 3;
        wAlarmWord2.0       := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_AB > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel A drifted: Quarantine A, vote on 1oo2 of (B, C) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor A Drifted *)

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_BC > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel B drifted: Quarantine B, vote on 1oo2 of (A, C) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor B Drifted *)

    ELSIF (rTMR1_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) AND (rTMR1_Diff_CA > c_rTMR1_MaxDeviation_degC) THEN
        (* Channel C drifted: Quarantine C, vote on 1oo2 of (A, B) *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC) * 0.5;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE; (* Sensor C Drifted *)

    ELSE
        (* Complete Consensus Loss: Multi-sensor divergence *)
        rVotedMOFTemp_degC  := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) / 3.0;
        iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 0;
        wAlarmWord1.4       := TRUE; (* TMR1 Total Consensus Loss *)
        bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
        iState              := 999;
    END_IF;

ELSIF bTMR1_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSIF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanC_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_C_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSIF bTMR1_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR1_ChanB_Valid THEN
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC := (rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_A_degC + rMOFBedCoreTemp_TMR_B_degC) * 0.5;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord2.0      := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedMOFTemp_degC  := 25.0;
    iTMR1_HealthyCount  := 0;
    wAlarmWord1.4       := TRUE;
    bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
    iState              := 999;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------
   TMR ENGINE 2: Potable Water Electrical Conductivity (Channels A, B, C)
   ------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bTMR2_ChanA_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);
bTMR2_ChanB_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);
bTMR2_ChanC_Valid := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm >= c_rTMR2_MinRange_uScm) AND
                     (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm <= c_rTMR2_MaxRange_uScm);

rTMR2_Diff_AB := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm);
rTMR2_Diff_BC := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm);
rTMR2_Diff_CA := ABS(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm - rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm);

IF bTMR2_ChanA_Valid AND bTMR2_ChanB_Valid AND bTMR2_ChanC_Valid THEN
    IF (rTMR2_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND
       (rTMR2_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND
       (rTMR2_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm
                                          - MIN(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm, MIN(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm, rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm))
                                          - MAX(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm, MAX(rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm, rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm));
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 3;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := FALSE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_BC <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_AB > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_CA <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_BC > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSIF (rTMR2_Diff_AB <= c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) AND (rTMR2_Diff_CA > c_rTMR2_MaxDeviation_uScm) THEN
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm) * 0.5;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord2.1      := TRUE;

    ELSE
        rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := (rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_A_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_B_uScm + rConductivityPostMineral_TMR_C_uScm) / 3.0;
        iTMR2_HealthyCount := 0;
        wAlarmWord2.2      := TRUE; (* TMR2 Consensus Lost: Force divert *)
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm := 10.0;
    iTMR2_HealthyCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord2.2      := TRUE;
    bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := FALSE;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iTMR1_HealthyCount = 2) OR (iTMR2_HealthyCount = 2);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: THERMODYNAMIC SIPS ADSORPTION / DESORPTION KINETIC ESTIMATION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rBedTemp_Kelvin := rVotedMOFTemp_degC + 273.15;

(* Magnus-Tetens saturation water vapor pressure calculation *)
IF rVotedMOFTemp_degC >= 0.0 THEN
    rSaturationPressure_mbar := 6.1078 * EXPT(10.0, (7.5 * rVotedMOFTemp_degC) / (237.3 + rVotedMOFTemp_degC));
ELSE
    rSaturationPressure_mbar := 6.1078 * EXPT(10.0, (9.5 * rVotedMOFTemp_degC) / (265.5 + rVotedMOFTemp_degC));
END_IF;

(* Water vapor pressure in sorption reactor *)
IF (iState = 10) THEN
    (* Adsorption: Open to ambient air *)
    rWaterVaporPressure_mbar := rSaturationPressure_mbar * (rAmbientHumidity_pctRH / 100.0);
ELSE
    (* Desorption under vacuum stripping: Bound by chamber total pressure *)
    rWaterVaporPressure_mbar := MIN(rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar, rSaturationPressure_mbar);
END_IF;

(* Sips Temperature-Dependent Affinity Constant b(T) *)
rSipsAffinity_b := c_rb0_mbar * EXP( (c_rQst_kJkg * c_rMolarMassWater_kgmol * 1000.0) / (c_rRgas_JmolK * rBedTemp_Kelvin) );

(* Dimensionless pressure potential: (b * P_vap)^n *)
rDimensionlessPressureTerm := rSipsAffinity_b * rWaterVaporPressure_mbar;
IF rDimensionlessPressureTerm > 0.001 THEN
    rDimensionlessPressureTerm := EXPT(rDimensionlessPressureTerm, c_rSipsExponent_n);
    rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg   := c_rqmax_gkg * ( rDimensionlessPressureTerm / (1.0 + rDimensionlessPressureTerm) );
ELSE
    rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg   := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Linear Driving Force (LDF) Dynamic Mass Transfer Rate *)
rMassTransferRate_kgs := 0.0125 * ((rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg - rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg) / 1000.0) * rMOF_Mass_kg;

(* Integrate Moisture Loading across task scan *)
rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg + ((rMassTransferRate_kgs / rMOF_Mass_kg) * 1000.0 * c_rCyclePeriod_s);
IF rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg > c_rqmax_gkg THEN
    rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := c_rqmax_gkg;
ELSIF rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg < 0.0 THEN
    rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Condensate Siphon Volumetric Production Rate *)
rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct := rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct - rPrevCondensateLevel_pct;
rPrevCondensateLevel_pct  := rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct;
IF (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct > 0.0) AND (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct < 15.0) THEN
    rInstantaneousProductionRate_Lh := (rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct / 100.0) * rCondensateVolumePerPct_L * (3600.0 / c_rCyclePeriod_s);
    rEstimatedWaterYield_L          := rEstimatedWaterYield_L + ((rDeltaCondensateLevel_pct / 100.0) * rCondensateVolumePerPct_L);
ELSE
    rInstantaneousProductionRate_Lh := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Latent Heat Recovery Power Calculation: Q_rec = m_dot * c_p * Delta T *)
IF rCondenserCoolantFlow_Lh > 50.0 THEN
    rLatentHeatRecovered_kW := (rCondenserCoolantFlow_Lh / 3600.0) * 3.85 * (* Glycol cp kJ/(kg*K) *)
                               MAX(0.0, (rCondenserCoolantOutletTemp_degC - rCondenserCoolantInletTemp_degC));
ELSE
    rLatentHeatRecovered_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Germicidal UV-C Dose Calculation: Dose [mJ/cm2] = Intensity [mW/cm2] * Residence_Time [s] *)
IF rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh > 0.5 THEN
    rCalculatedUVDose_mJcm2 := rUVSterilizationIrradiance_mWcm2 * ( (rUVReactorVolume_L / rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh) * 3600.0 );
ELSE
    rCalculatedUVDose_mJcm2 := rUVSterilizationIrradiance_mWcm2 * 120.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING KERNEL
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Deviation State Vector: x = [Delta T_bed, Delta P_desorp, Delta q_loading, Delta T_cond]^T *)
aStateVector_x[1] := rVotedMOFTemp_degC - rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC;
aStateVector_x[2] := rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar - rRecipeDesorptionPressSP_mbar;
aStateVector_x[3] := rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg - 250.0;
aStateVector_x[4] := rCondenserSurfaceTemp_degC - rRecipeCondenserTempSP_degC;

(* Assemble Disturbance Vector: w = [Delta Solar_G, Delta T_amb]^T *)
aDisturbance_w[1] := rSolarIrradiance_Wm2 - 800.0;
aDisturbance_w[2] := rAmbientAirTemp_degC - 35.0;

(* Discrete State Predictor: x_hat(k+1) = A_d * x(k) + B_ud * u(k-1) + B_wd * w(k) *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aPredictedState_x[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_A_d[i, j] * aStateVector_x[j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_B_ud[i, j] * aControlInput_u[j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 2 DO
        aPredictedState_x[i] := aPredictedState_x[i] + (aMatrix_B_wd[i, j] * aDisturbance_w[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* MPC Linear Gradient: g_mpc = B_ud^T * Q * x_hat + R * du_prev *)
(* Diagonal Tracking Weights: Q = diag([1.80, 0.45, 0.20, 1.20]), R = diag([0.50, 0.35, 0.25]) *)
aGradient_g[1] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 1] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 1] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 1] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 1] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.50 * aDeltaControl_du[1]);

aGradient_g[2] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 2] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 2] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 2] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 2] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.35 * aDeltaControl_du[2]);

aGradient_g[3] := (aMatrix_B_ud[1, 3] * 1.80 * aPredictedState_x[1]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[2, 3] * 0.45 * aPredictedState_x[2]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[3, 3] * 0.20 * aPredictedState_x[3]) +
                  (aMatrix_B_ud[4, 3] * 1.20 * aPredictedState_x[4]) +
                  (0.25 * aDeltaControl_du[3]);

(* Unconstrained Newton Step via Inverse Hessian: Delta u_raw = - H^-1 * g *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aDeltaControl_du[i] := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaControl_du[i] - (aHessian_Inv[i, j] * aGradient_g[j]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Iteration Loop for Box Constraints & Actuator Limits *)
FOR k_iter := 1 TO 3 DO
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        (* Slew Rate Saturation *)
        IF aDeltaControl_du[i] > aDeltaMax[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaMax[i];
        ELSIF aDeltaControl_du[i] < aDeltaMin[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aDeltaMin[i];
        END_IF;

        (* Position Constraint Projection: u_min <= u(k-1) + Delta u <= u_max *)
        rTempCalc1 := aControlInput_u[i] + aDeltaControl_du[i];
        IF rTempCalc1 > aControlMax[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aControlMax[i] - aControlInput_u[i];
        ELSIF rTempCalc1 < aControlMin[i] THEN
            aDeltaControl_du[i] := aControlMin[i] - aControlInput_u[i];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Compute Quadratic Objective Cost for Telemetry: J = 1/2 * du^T * H * du + g^T * du *)
rMPC_ObjectiveCost := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempCalc2 := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempCalc2 := rTempCalc2 + (aHessian_H[i, j] * aDeltaControl_du[j]);
    END_FOR;
    rMPC_ObjectiveCost := rMPC_ObjectiveCost + (0.5 * aDeltaControl_du[i] * rTempCalc2) + (aGradient_g[i] * aDeltaControl_du[i]);
END_FOR;

(* Update Actuator Control Positions if in Active Automatic Desorption *)
IF (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40) THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
        aControlInput_u[i] := aControlInput_u[i] + aDeltaControl_du[i];
        IF aControlInput_u[i] > 100.0 THEN
            aControlInput_u[i] := 100.0;
        ELSIF aControlInput_u[i] < 0.0 THEN
            aControlInput_u[i] := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Control loop managed specifically per state *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 AWH HARVESTING BATCH PHASES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE: System quiescent, sensors live, waiting for cycle start *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := FALSE;
        bCycleComplete                      := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord                   := 16#0001; (* Standby Ready Bit *)

        (* Permissive Check for Automated Diurnal Adsorption Start *)
        IF bEnable AND bEStopOk AND (wAlarmWord1 = 0) AND bStartCycle THEN
            IF rAmbientHumidity_pctRH >= c_rMinAmbientRH_Permissive_pct THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Nocturnal Adsorption Charging *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord2.3 := TRUE; (* Ambient RH critically low *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_NOCTURNAL_ADSORPTION_CHARGING: Fresh ambient air circulated through MOF bed *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := TRUE; (* Equalize chamber *)

        (* Open motorized ambient air louvers for low-pressure convective sorption *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := TRUE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0003; (* Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Adsorption Active *)

        (* Sorption Completion Criteria: Loading reaches 85% of theoretical equilibrium or diurnal timer expires *)
        tAdsorptionSoakTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#14400S); (* 4-hour max nocturnal soak *)

        IF (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg >= (rEquilibriumLoading_g_kg * 0.88)) OR
           (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg >= 280.0) OR
           (rSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 450.0) (* Diurnal sun rising *) OR
           tAdsorptionSoakTimer.Q THEN

            tAdsorptionSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := FALSE;
            bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := FALSE;
            bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd  := FALSE;
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Chamber Evacuation *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_PRE_DESORPTION_EVACUATION: Chamber isolation & rough vacuum pumpdown *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd  := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd  := FALSE;
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW       := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0007; (* Bit 2: Evacuation Active *)

        (* Open vacuum line isolation valve and spin up dry scroll pump *)
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm            := 2400.0;

        (* Engage condenser cooling loop in preparation for vapor condensation *)
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := 40.0;

        tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#180S);
        IF (rDesorptionChamberPress_mbar <= (rRecipeDesorptionPressSP_mbar * 1.15)) THEN
            tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Target vacuum achieved, initiate Solar Thermal Desorption *)
        ELSIF tEvacuationStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            tEvacuationStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmWord1.5 := TRUE; (* Evacuation Timeout Fault *)
            bSystemAlarmSummary := TRUE;
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_SOLAR_THERMAL_VACUUM_DESORPTION: Stripping desorption driven by Solar HTF & MPC *)
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd        := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord                  := 16#000F; (* Bit 3: Desorption Stripping Active *)

        (* Apply MPC Actuator Outputs *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct     := aControlInput_u[1];
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm      := (aControlInput_u[2] / 100.0) * 3600.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := aControlInput_u[3];

        (* Auxiliary Electric Trim Heater: Supplements if solar irradiance drops below threshold *)
        IF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC < (rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC - 5.0)) AND (rSolarHTFSupplyTemp_degC < 85.0) THEN
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 7.5; (* 50% auxiliary thermal boost *)
        ELSIF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC >= rRecipeDesorptionTempSP_degC) THEN
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Condensate Siphon Auto-Transfer to Buffer Reservoir *)
        IF rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct >= 75.0 THEN
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := TRUE;
        ELSIF rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct <= 15.0 THEN
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition Criteria: Sorbent moisture loading depleted (< 35 g/kg) *)
        tDesorptionRunTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#7200S); (* 2-hour max desorption plateau *)
        IF (rMOFWaterLoading_g_kg <= 35.0) OR tDesorptionRunTimer.Q THEN
            tDesorptionRunTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Advance to Condensation Drain & Latent Recovery Soak *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_CONDENSATION_LATENT_HEAT_RECOVERY: Final vapor strip & latent heat optimization *)
        wSystemStatusWord                  := 16#001F; (* Bit 4: Condensation Finalizing *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct           := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW              := 0.0;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := TRUE;

        (* Maintain vacuum stripping pump at idle speed for residual vapor capture *)
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm      := 1200.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct := 60.0;

        (* Modulate Latent Heat Regenerative Pre-Heat Diverter Valve *)
        IF rLatentHeatRecovered_kW > 1.5 THEN
            rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct := 85.0;
        ELSE
            rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Drain remaining condensate to intermediate tank *)
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := TRUE;

        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q AND (rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct <= 5.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd := FALSE;
            rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm     := 0.0;
            bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd := FALSE;
            iState := 50; (* Advance to Bed Regeneration Cooling *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_POST_DESORPTION_BED_REGENERATION: Vacuum vent & cool-down to reset sorption potential *)
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#003F; (* Bit 5: Bed Cooling Active *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct    := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW       := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm     := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct:= 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct:= 0.0;

        (* Vent vacuum chamber with dry ambient purge *)
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd := TRUE;

        tRegenerationCoolTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#600S);
        IF (rVotedMOFTemp_degC <= 42.0) OR tRegenerationCoolTimer.Q THEN
            tRegenerationCoolTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd := FALSE;
            iState := 60; (* Advance to Potabilization & Remineralization *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_PERISTALTIC_MINERALIZATION_UV: Inline closed-loop remineralization & UV-C sterilization *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#007F; (* Bit 6: Mineralization Active *)

        (* Energize UV-C Germicidal Ballast *)
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd := TRUE;

        (* Closed-Loop Digital PI Remineralization Control *)
        rConductivityError_uScm    := rRecipeTargetConductivity_uScm - rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm;
        rConductivityIntegralAccum := rConductivityIntegralAccum + (rConductivityError_uScm * c_rCyclePeriod_s);

        (* Anti-Windup Clamping on PI Integrator *)
        IF rConductivityIntegralAccum > 1200.0 THEN
            rConductivityIntegralAccum := 1200.0;
        ELSIF rConductivityIntegralAccum < -400.0 THEN
            rConductivityIntegralAccum := -400.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Feedforward from treated water flow rate *)
        rPeristalticFeedforward_Lh := (rTreatedWaterFlow_Lh * (rRecipeTargetConductivity_uScm - rConductivityPreMineral_uScm)) /
                                      c_rConcentrateEnrichment_uScm_per_L;

        (* Total Peristaltic Dosing Command *)
        rPeristalticPI_Output_Lh := rPeristalticFeedforward_Lh +
                                    (c_rMineralKp * rConductivityError_uScm) +
                                    (c_rMineralKi * rConductivityIntegralAccum);

        IF rPeristalticPI_Output_Lh > 4.5 THEN
            rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh := 4.5;
        ELSIF rPeristalticPI_Output_Lh < 0.05 THEN
            rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh := 0.05;
        ELSE
            rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh := rPeristalticPI_Output_Lh;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Potability Standards for Product Diversion *)
        IF (rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm >= (rRecipeTargetConductivity_uScm * 0.85)) AND
           (rVotedMineralConductivity_uScm <= (rRecipeTargetConductivity_uScm * 1.15)) AND
           (rFinishedWaterPH >= 6.8) AND (rFinishedWaterPH <= 8.2) AND
           (rCalculatedUVDose_mJcm2 >= rRecipeMinUVDose_mJcm2) AND
           (rUVSterilizationIrradiance_mWcm2 >= c_rMinUVIrradiance_Trip_mWcm2) THEN

            (* Water meets WHO/EPA potability specifications -> Route to Finished Storage Tank *)
            bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Advance to Potable Storage Transfer *)
        ELSE
            (* Water out of spec -> Recirculate to Raw Condensate Tank *)
            bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_POTABLE_WATER_TRANSFER_STORAGE: Delivery to finished distribution reservoir *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#00FF; (* Bit 7: Potable Delivery Active *)

        (* Maintain UV-C and Peristaltic dosing active during transfer *)
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd := TRUE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd := TRUE;

        (* Check Finished Reservoir Level *)
        IF rProductWaterTankLevel_pct >= 98.0 THEN
            (* Tank full: Cease transfer *)
            bProductWaterDivertValveCmd  := FALSE;
            rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh := 0.0;
            bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd    := FALSE;
            bCycleComplete               := TRUE;
            iState := 80; (* Complete cycle, enter clean-in-place purge *)
        END_IF;

        (* If raw condensate depleted, complete cycle *)
        IF rCondensateCollectorLevel_pct <= 2.0 THEN
            bProductWaterDivertValveCmd  := FALSE;
            rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh := 0.0;
            bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd    := FALSE;
            bCycleComplete               := TRUE;
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CLEAN_IN_PLACE_DESORPTION_PURGE: Cleanse, sensor auto-zero & reset *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#01FF; (* Bit 8: CIP Purge Active *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := FALSE;

        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 0; (* Return to Standby Ready for next diurnal cycle *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN: Controlled safe de-energization & energy dump *)
        rCmdSolarHTFModValve_pct            := 0.0;
        rCmdAuxHeaterPower_kW               := 0.0;
        rCmdVacuumPumpSpeed_rpm             := 0.0;
        rCmdCondenserCoolantPump_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdHeatRecoveryDiverter_pct        := 0.0;
        rCmdPeristalticDosingRate_Lh        := 0.0;
        bAdsorptionIntakeDamperCmd          := FALSE;
        bAdsorptionExhaustDamperCmd         := FALSE;
        bDesorptionVacuumIsolationValveCmd  := FALSE;
        bCondensateDrainSolenoidCmd         := FALSE;
        bProductWaterDivertValveCmd         := FALSE;
        bUVDisinfectionReactorCmd           := FALSE;
        bVacuumChamberVentValveCmd          := TRUE; (* Equalize vacuum chamber safely *)

        wSystemStatusWord := 16#F999; (* Emergency Abort Word *)

        (* Manual Reset Interlock: Requires active reset push button and healthy safety line *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk THEN
            wAlarmWord1         := 0;
            wAlarmWord2         := 0;
            bSystemAlarmSummary := FALSE;
            iState              := 0; (* Return to standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: ISA-18.2 ALARM AGGREGATION & SYSTEM DIAGNOSTICS UPDATE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update summary alarm bit *)
bSystemAlarmSummary := (wAlarmWord1 <> 0);

(* Output active state index for supervisory HMI/SCADA *)
iActiveStateIndex := iState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
